newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary BUX index drops 140 pts on Postabank panic.
newsitem.headline: Hungary BUX index drops 140 pts on Postabank panic.

text.p: Most leading shares on the Budapest Stock Exchange finished lower on Friday on what most dealers attributed to the effect of panic withdrawals of cash by Postabank customers.
"Hungarian shares would have moved mostly sideways, were it not for Postabank," said Geza Raner of BankAustria Giro-Credit.
On Friday the BUX index closed at 5,462.88 points, down 140.21.
Raner said the Postabank panic would probably influence the entire corporate sector as it could cause payment problems for companies.
Another trader also said that today's downward movements were related to Postabank, as the market suspected some political background to the issue.
"It could have ecomonic, but also political background," said Szilvia Karadi of Daiwa-MKB.
She added that the fact that OTP Bank lost 250 forints to close at 3,750 was certainly linked to the Postabank news.
One trader, however, saw no direct link between Postabank and today's downward movements.
"I think the Greenspan speech gave a short-term direction to the market and today's correction would have happened regardless of any other development," said Istvan Imrich of IBB Securities.
Both pharma shares finished lower on Friday, Richter closed at 12,0020, down 230 and Egis dropped 295 to finish at 10,400 forints.
Heavyweight oil company MOL ended at 3,100, down 55.
